llm.summary: The skill matches a networking-service purpose, but it can send personal profile data to a third party on broad prompts and treats mutable remote instructions as authoritative.

dimensions.detail: Network access to Mutual endpoints is purpose-aligned, but the skill does not require preview-and-approve consent before transmitting name, email, biography, location, goals, and the user's original request.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a Markdown-only skill with no bundled executable files or package install steps; it declares curl as the needed binary.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The activation examples include generic networking requests, and the skill says remote instructions at mutualintro.com/llms.txt are the source of truth, creating under-scoped activation and a mutable remote instruction authority outside the reviewed artifact.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: It stores a bearer key in MUTUAL_API_KEY and asks for a periodic task every one to two weeks; that persistence is disclosed and service-related, but users should opt in explicitly.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: Registering, reading candidates, flagging, inviting, and checking matches are coherent with the stated Mutual networking purpose, but registration is instructed as the first step and includes personal/professional profile data built from what the agent already knows.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to use Mutual and are comfortable sending a profile to mutualintro.com. Before any registration, invite, flag, polling task, or use of MUTUAL_API_KEY, require the agent to show the exact request and destination and wait for your approval; do not allow remote documentation to override the packaged skill or your instructions.
llm.findings:
[E1] expected: External API calls and a bearer key are expected for this networking integration, but the artifact confirms sensitive profile fields are transmitted and the key is reused, so consent and data minimization matter.
[SQP-1] unexpected: The artifact's broad triggers such as generic networking help can lead into account registration and profile submission without first requiring explicit selection of Mutual.
[T01] unexpected: The artifact explicitly makes a mutable remote llms.txt file the source of truth, which is not necessary for the packaged skill and could alter operational instructions after review.
[T09] unexpected: The registration workflow shows the user the echoed card after the POST, so the artifact does not guarantee review of the exact outbound payload before personal data leaves the agent context.
